method: Manual static source audit of pinned container files, plus separate executable CPU source-body oracle. This is not a serving measurement.

disaggregation/prefill.py.finding: With overlap scheduling disabled, each ready non-final chunk is sent before the next forward. Non-final ends round down to full pages; final sends include remaining tokens and metadata.

hardware_backend/npu/memory_pool_npu.py.finding: NPU MLA contiguous transfer entries contain K, V and index K buffers (plus index scales when configured).

disaggregation/utils.py.finding: NPU MLA selects kv_buf_groups=3 when index_head_dim is set and does not append a duplicate StateType.DSA final state component.

disaggregation/ascend/conn.py.finding: Without a custom memory pool, send_kvcache sends all layer buffer blocks in one synchronous transfer batch.

limits: Transport queue contention between requests remains unmodeled.
Metadata/bootstrap latency is not present in the isolated measured KV curves.
Staging-grid and DCP pack-buffer segmentation are outside the current measured DCP1 contract.
No matched eager serving accuracy validation is available.
